sefer_yetzirah_refs.note: This exact phrase ('its end is embedded in its beginning and its beginning in its end') is a direct, well-known formula from Sefer Yetzirah 1:7 ('נעוץ סופן בתחלתן ותחלתן בסופן'); this page's version ('ותחלה באמצע') varies slightly from the standard Yetzirah wording and is presented in a compressed parenthetical alongside a sefirot-name list -- flagged as a strong but not verbatim-identical candidate citation.
